reviewer_notes: This is a methodological energy-audit paper that develops 17 intensity-ratio EnPIs for two electric arc furnace steel mills. The two mills are recorded as two applications (A1 = Mill 1, 480 kton/yr; A2 = Mill 2, 190 kton/yr). The 17 EnPIs share one functional form (energy or emissions per ton, or kWh per Nm3 of compressed air) and were grouped into models by dependent variable / energy vector; process-level values (ACC, RIF, FOR, LAM, TT, ACO) are recorded as separate metric entries within each model's energy_result block, since no statistical fitting is performed and there is no in-sample fit metric. The paper also reports a price EnPI 'C/t-ACC' (158 for Mill 1, 204 for Mill 2) which is a product-price indicator rather than an energy-performance model, so it was not given its own model; the reviewer may wish to note it. The 'validation' in Table II is a comparison of computed EnPIs against literature benchmark ranges (labelled Good/Bad/New), not a statistical out-of-sample validation, so out_of_sample_validation is coded not applicable. Mill/plant country is not stated (the consulting company is in Italy).
